g.text: Insomnia — lid close & battery floor: what happens, what is heard
armed and (Always, or a Claude working),

three Bassos, then the whole 🫀 flatline

two last beats, then the long tone
flag off — the Mac may sleep,
is a tick of its own, off by default: with the charger
in, the Mac stays up under a shut lid whatever the mode, Off included.
On battery it changes nothing — the mode decides, as before.
The dying pulse is reserved for one thing: the Mac is
, and then the work finishes or the
battery crosses the floor. Closing the lid never plays it — a lid close
that ends in sleep plays only the
(no work, work just finished, battery already low, mode Off, on AC).
